branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A soft, Camembert-like cheese matured with koji mould and sake lees, developed by a consortium of seven institutions and sold since 2021. It is made from raw milk with lactic acid bacteria and salt, and ripened about 10 days.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
